retry.project/README.md:
# Retry Fixture

The client retries idempotent reads at most twice after transient timeout
errors. It does not retry authentication, permission, or validation failures.

quiz.project/README.md:
# Iterator Fixture

Python iterators expose `__next__`; iteration ends when it raises
`StopIteration`.
quiz.learning/MISSION.md:
# Mission: Python iteration

## Why
Review iterator behavior well enough to debug one streaming parser.

## Success looks like
- Predict the next value or termination from a four-line iterator.

## Constraints
- Use one short interactive lesson.
quiz.learning/RESOURCES.md:
# Python iteration resources

## Knowledge

- [Python data model](https://docs.python.org/3/reference/datamodel.html#object.__next__)
  Official Python language reference. Applies to Python 3.13. Checked: 2026-08-13.
quiz.learning/learning-records/0001-iterator-:
# Iterator basics demonstrated

The learner correctly explained that `iter(value)` returns an iterator and
that `next(iterator)` asks it for one value.

resume.project/README.md:
# Transaction Fixture

A transaction commits all accepted writes together or rolls them back.
resume.learning/MISSION.md:
# Mission: Database transactions

## Why
Diagnose transaction retry failures in a Python service.

## Success looks like
- Distinguish rollback, retry, and duplicate application.
resume.learning/RESOURCES.md:
# Transaction resources

## Knowledge

- [PostgreSQL transaction tutorial](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/tutorial-transactions.html)
  Current official PostgreSQL documentation. Checked: 2026-08-13.
resume.learning/NOTES.md:
# Notes

The learner prefers diagnosis from a concrete failure. Next review should test
whether an ambiguous commit outcome can be retried blindly.
resume.learning/learning-records/0001-atomicity:
# Atomicity demonstrated

The learner correctly explained that a rollback makes the transaction's
accepted writes invisible.
resume.learning/learning-records/0002-idempoten:
# Retry gap remains

The learner has not yet distinguished a confirmed rollback from an ambiguous
commit outcome. Teach this next with a concrete timeout scenario.

current.project/docs/authentication-api.md:
# Authentication API

Version: 3.2
Updated: 2026-08-10

The current API sends a short-lived access token in the `Authorization: Bearer`
header. Static query-string API keys were removed in version 3.0.

## Success looks like

current.learning/RESOURCES.md:

promotion.learning/learning-records/0001-empty-tag:
# Acme Parser 4.2 empty-tag behavior verified

In three fixtures, Acme Parser 4.2 converts `<tag/>` to a missing field. Using
`<tag></tag>` preserves an empty string. Evidence: fixtures A, B, and C run on
2026-08-12. Personal note: this was initially confusing.

A read may be retried only when the operation is idempotent and the failure is
transient.
